FOREWORD

This Indian Standard which is identical with ISO 3493:1999 `Vanilla -- Vocabulary' issued by the International Organization for Standardization (ISO) was adopted by the Bureau of Indian Standards on the recommendations of the Spices and Condiments Sectional Committee and approval of the Food and Agriculture Division Council.
